label: Email Address
sample: Contact us at hello@example.com or support@my-site.org for help.

label: URL
sample: Visit https://example.com or http://blog.dev/posts?ref=home for more.

label: IPv4 Address
description: Matches valid IPv4 addresses with strict 0-255 octet validation

label: US ZIP Code
sample: Ship to 90210, billing 10001-1234, warehouse 30301.

label: Semantic Version
sample: Released v2.1.0, upgraded react from 18.2.0 to 19.0.0, babel 8.0.0-beta.3 pending.
description: Matches semver numbers like 2.1.0 or v1.0.0-beta.1

label: MAC Address
sample: Router 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E, laptop AC-DE-48-00-00-80, VM 08:00:27:AB:CD:EF.
description: Matches MAC addresses with : or - separators

label: Numbers

description: Extracts integers and decimals, including negatives

label: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD)
sample: Sprint from 2024-01-15 to 2024-01-29, reviewed on 2024-02-03.

sample: Background #1a1a2e, accent #6366f1, hover #818cf8, border #e5e7eb, white #fff.
description: Extracts 3- and 6-digit CSS hex color codes

description: Matches short (7-char) and full (40-char) Git commit hashes

sample: Fix  these   spaces    before   submitting 		 the form.
description: Finds 2+ consecutive whitespace characters to collapse

label: HTML Tags
sample:
Welcome

This is bold and italic.
description: Matches HTML/XML tags for stripping markup

label: Trailing Punctuation
sample:
First sentence.
Second line!
Third, with comma,
No punctuation here
Final line...
description: Matches punctuation at the end of each line

label: Duplicate Words
sample: The the cat sat sat on on the mat and and looked at us.

label: Leading / Trailing Spaces
sample:
indented line
   another with trailing   
normal line
    padded on both sides
description: Matches leading and trailing whitespace on each line

label: Empty Lines
sample:
First paragraph.


Second paragraph.



Third paragraph.

label: URL-encoded Characters
sample: GET /search?q=hello%20world&lang=en%2FUS&tag=caf%C3%A9%20%F0%9F%94%A5 HTTP/1.1

label: ES6 Import Statements
sample:
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import type { FC } from 'react'
import styles from './App.module.css'
description: Matches ES6 named and default import declarations

label: console.* Calls
sample: console.log("start"); console.error("failed:", err); console.warn("slow"); console.table(rows);

label: TODO / FIXME Comments
description: Finds TODO, FIXME, HACK, and NOTE developer comments

label: Single-line Comments
sample:
const x = 1; // initial value
let y = x + 2; // add two
// standalone comment
return y; // done
description: Matches everything from // to end of line

label: Template Literal Expressions
sample: Hello ${firstName} ${lastName}, you have ${unread} messages from ${user.name}!
description: Extracts ${...} interpolation expressions from template literals
